description: Use this when the user wants to view their projects. Returns one page at a time: set limit to the number of projects wanted and page through the rest instead of loading all of them. Supports filtering by team, status, date ranges, and text search.

includeFormer.description: Also list the projects the user has own time entries on but left (the project, its team or organization). They are read-only for the user; leave this off when picking a project for new time.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return, such as 5 for five projects. Defaults to 20.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Use with limit to fetch subsequent pages.

projectIds.description: Optional array of project IDs to filter specific projects

search.description: Optional search query to filter projects by title (partial match supported)

sort.description: Sort field for projects: alpha=alphabetical, alphaNum=alphanumeric, client=by client name, duration=total time tracked, created=creation date, status=active/inactive

status.description: Filter by project status. "active" = non-archived, "inactive" = archived, "all" = both. Defaults to "all" if not specified.

taskEndDate.description: Filter projects with tasks ending on or before this date (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD)

taskRateId.description: Filter projects containing tasks with this specific rate ID

taskStartDate.description: Filter projects with tasks starting on or after this date (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD)

taskType.description: Filter projects containing tasks of a specific type

taskUserIds.description: Filter projects containing tasks assigned to these user IDs

teamId.description: Optional team ID to filter projects belonging to a specific team

teamIds.description: Optional array of team IDs to filter projects belonging to multiple teams

name: project_list

projects.description: List of projects matching the criteria

title: List Projects
